content:
emily.m: Thanks everyone — quick live thread from the all-hands Q&A. Can we get tight clarifications on launch windows for the API, Console, and Optimize features? Specifically: hard GA targets, canary timing, and any cross-team deps.

anna.ceo: Short answers: API GA = mid-July, Console feature parity v1 = early August, Optimize beta = late June. Canary windows will be staggered; I'll have more in a follow-up doc.

jon.product: Adding context — API GA assumes no major perf regressions from the current canary (we're watching tail latency). If we see >5% P99 increase we push the window.

sara.eng: From runtime: canary for the new batching knobs can start 05/12 in staging, 05/19 in limited prod. We need 2 weeks of stable telemetry before broad canary.

ryan.devex: DevEx note — Console v1 parity includes telemetry views + rollout controls. UX freeze is 05/05, so anything past that will be a follow-up patch.

ops_lee: Ops checklist: capacity reserve for Dedicated customers must be in place before Console rollout to avoid allocation churn. We're targeting k8s node pool changes 05/15.

emily.m: Quick clarify — when you say "mid-July" for API GA, is that a hard date to communicate to customers?

anna.ceo: It's our public target but with a caveat: it depends on canary health and the Optimize beta's impact on cost/perf. We'll aim to announce a firm date by 06/20.

jon.product: Feature-level callouts: streaming + function-calls API are highest priority for GA. Optimize's initial knobs (batching suggestions, quantization hints) will be opt-in during beta.

sara.eng: TL;DR rollout sequence I recommend: 1) staging canary (05/12), 2) limited-prod canary with 10% traffic (05/19), 3) scale to 50% over two weeks if no regressions (05/26 onward), 4) GA gate at mid-July.

ryan.devex: UX/Docs plan: we will ship a "canary playbook" and short migration guide by 05/08. That will include example configs, recommended batch sizes, and a troubleshooting checklist.

ops_lee: Dependency flags: we need feature-flag support in the control plane for Optimize by 05/10. Platform infra team, can you confirm?

deploy-bot: Canary deployment triggered: staging/batching-knobs - started 2024-05-12T02:00:00Z :rocket:

jon.product: Also noting risks: if Optimize beta shows large variance in unit cost, we may delay Console GA to avoid shipping confusing defaults.

emily.m: Great — can leadership confirm a single doc with all dates and the conditionals? Would help comms.

anna.ceo: Yes — I'll publish a short timeline doc by EOD Friday with conditional gates and owner contacts. Expect a ping here when live. :thumbsup:

sara.eng: I'll add the telemetry thresholds (P50/P95/P99 targets) to that doc as well.

ryan.devex: I'll mirror the timeline into the docs repo and add the canary playbook link when available.

emily.m: Thanks all — marking this thread resolved for the Q&A. Follow-ups will be in the timeline doc. :white_check_mark:
